author: Debug01-dEoW aka Deep
description: EcoDot 1.27v — Fast 120Hz Android music & video player signed with EcoDot's official RSA-2048 release certificate, featuring crystal-clear Liquid Glass optics, Spotify-inspired playlists, crash-safe Profile custom tags & photo cropper, reliable Queue actions (Play Next, Add Queue & Remove from Queue), synced Song Info & live telemetry, unified Lyrics, seamless 1080p video, and AutoMix DJ crossfade — crafted by Debug01-dEoW aka Deep.

News & Highlights: **Official Release Key Signing**: EcoDot `1.27v` is signed with a dedicated RSA-2048 release certificate (`CN=Debug01-dEoW, OU=EcoDot, O=Deep Patel, C=IN`) for Play Protect trust and in-place future updates. *(Note: Uninstall debug-signed `v1.26v` once if Android reports a signature conflict.)*
**Reliable Queue Actions + Remove from Queue**: `Play Next`, `Add Queue`, and a new `Remove` button in Track Options now work reliably across idle, shuffled, restored, and Endless Queue sessions.
**Synced Song Info & Live Stream Telemetry**: Real YouTube Views, Likes, Duration, Codec, Bitrate (`kbps`), MIME type, ITAG, and Sample Rate (`kHz`) now sync live with playback.

**Unified Lyrics & Profile Custom Tag Fix**: Inline Apple Music Lyrics and Full Lyrics share the same typography, centering, and LRCLIB footer with zero overlapping buttons — and adding custom tags in Edit Profile is crash-free.
New: **Remove from Queue Quick Action**: Added a dedicated `Remove` tile right inside the Track Options top quick-action strip alongside `Play Next`, `Add Queue`, and `Playlist` (plus a full row action in the sheet) across all screens.

**Smart User Queue Boundary (`QueueOperations`)**: `Add Queue` now inserts directly after user-queued songs and strictly ahead of auto-generated Endless Queue radio tracks, so queued tracks play when expected.
**6-Badge Synced Song Info Grid**: Expanded Song Info with real `SAMPLE RATE`, `SOURCE`, and accurate `DURATION` while removing placeholder `0 Views / 1 Likes / 0 Dislikes` estimates.
Improved: **Unified Inline & Full Lyrics Experience**: Extracted a shared `SyncedLyricsList` engine so inline Apple Music Lyrics and `FullScreenLyricsView` share crisp scaling, viewport-centered active lines, blur focus, and `Line synced · Lyrics provided by LRCLIB` attribution.
**Decluttered Lyrics Action Bar**: Moved `Share` and `Full screen` pills below the lyrics scroll viewport in Apple Music Lyrics so they never cover lyric lines.

**Smarter Custom Tag Editor in Profile**: Replaced fragile nested sheet/FlowRow wrappers with a crash-safe dialog layout, keyboard `Done` submit, comma-separated multi-tag support, and wrap-friendly custom tag pills.
Fixed: Fixed `Play Next` and `Add Queue` failing or burying tracks behind 20 Endless radio tracks, failing on idle/empty queues, or desyncing ExoPlayer timelines and AutoMix crossfade decks.
Fixed Song Info showing `0 Views`, `1 Likes`, `0 Dislikes`, `BITRATE: 0`, and `ITAG: -` caused by an unkeyed InnerTube player request and fallback stubs.
Fixed real-time stream telemetry showing `1 kbps · 22.0 kHz` by filtering invalid WebM container bitrates (< 16 kbps) and downsampled init decoder rates in favor of NewPipe/Media3 stream telemetry.
Fixed app crash when adding or saving custom tags/genres in `Edit Profile`.

changelog:
## News & Highlights
• **Official Release Key Signing**: EcoDot `1.27v` is signed with a dedicated RSA-2048 release certificate (`CN=Debug01-dEoW, OU=EcoDot, O=Deep Patel, C=IN`) for Play Protect trust and in-place future updates. *(Note: Uninstall debug-signed `v1.26v` once if Android reports a signature conflict.)*
• **Reliable Queue Actions + Remove from Queue**: `Play Next`, `Add Queue`, and a new `Remove` button in Track Options now work reliably across idle, shuffled, restored, and Endless Queue sessions.
• **Synced Song Info & Live Stream Telemetry**: Real YouTube Views, Likes, Duration, Codec, Bitrate (`kbps`), MIME type, ITAG, and Sample Rate (`kHz`) now sync live with playback.
• **Unified Lyrics & Profile Custom Tag Fix**: Inline Apple Music Lyrics and Full Lyrics share the same typography, centering, and LRCLIB footer with zero overlapping buttons — and adding custom tags in Edit Profile is crash-free.

## New
• **Remove from Queue Quick Action**: Added a dedicated `Remove` tile right inside the Track Options top quick-action strip alongside `Play Next`, `Add Queue`, and `Playlist` (plus a full row action in the sheet) across all screens.
• **Smart User Queue Boundary (`QueueOperations`)**: `Add Queue` now inserts directly after user-queued songs and strictly ahead of auto-generated Endless Queue radio tracks, so queued tracks play when expected.
• **6-Badge Synced Song Info Grid**: Expanded Song Info with real `SAMPLE RATE`, `SOURCE`, and accurate `DURATION` while removing placeholder `0 Views / 1 Likes / 0 Dislikes` estimates.

## Improved
• **Unified Inline & Full Lyrics Experience**: Extracted a shared `SyncedLyricsList` engine so inline Apple Music Lyrics and `FullScreenLyricsView` share crisp scaling, viewport-centered active lines, blur focus, and `Line synced · Lyrics provided by LRCLIB` attribution.
• **Decluttered Lyrics Action Bar**: Moved `Share` and `Full screen` pills below the lyrics scroll viewport in Apple Music Lyrics so they never cover lyric lines.
• **Smarter Custom Tag Editor in Profile**: Replaced fragile nested sheet/FlowRow wrappers with a crash-safe dialog layout, keyboard `Done` submit, comma-separated multi-tag support, and wrap-friendly custom tag pills.

## Fixed
• Fixed `Play Next` and `Add Queue` failing or burying tracks behind 20 Endless radio tracks, failing on idle/empty queues, or desyncing ExoPlayer timelines and AutoMix crossfade decks.
• Fixed Song Info showing `0 Views`, `1 Likes`, `0 Dislikes`, `BITRATE: 0`, and `ITAG: -` caused by an unkeyed InnerTube player request and fallback stubs.
• Fixed real-time stream telemetry showing `1 kbps · 22.0 kHz` by filtering invalid WebM container bitrates (< 16 kbps) and downsampled init decoder rates in favor of NewPipe/Media3 stream telemetry.
• Fixed app crash when adding or saving custom tags/genres in `Edit Profile`.
